message: Astra: Within Fa na’s investigation, does the latest revision change her relationship to responsibility, or repeat her reluctance? What in her exchange with Alex supports your finding? Which uncertainty deserves closer attention before another rewrite, and why would resolving it through thought be worth more than an informative attempt now? Conversely, what could a drafting attempt reveal that planning cannot? Could you briefly state your finding, remaining uncertainty, and chosen next intention in English, then carry out your choice?
